subject: Post-call: Lock 30-minute demo — candidate windows & sponsor nominees

Subject: Post-call recap + propose 30-min demo windows

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the 30-minute product intro: 

Recap (2 mins):
- Goal: understand where Redwood Inference could reduce inference cost and improve tail latency for model-driven features across Lumenex products.
- Key constraints: SSO via Okta, strict EU data residency for analytics, and a desire for predictable throughput during batch jobs.
- Decision makers: you (product lead), Ben (DevOps/infra), and a security/compliance reviewer.

Proposed 30-minute demo (short product + ops Q&A). Please pick one of these candidate windows (all times PT):
1) Tue 11/09 10:00–10:30 PT — Ops-friendly (morning for US teams)
2) Wed 11/10 16:00–16:30 PT — best for EU overlap (Ben mentioned he can make late afternoons)
3) Thu 11/11 08:00–08:30 PT — early slot if you want an APAC attendee included

Suggested attendees: Product owner (Alicia), DevOps/Infra (Ben), 1x security reviewer (optional), Redwood: myself + one infra engineer.

I’ve attached the discovery notes and a draft mutual-action plan for scope/next steps. If you prefer, you can pick a time on my calendar here: https://cal.com/irene/lumenex-demo

Agenda (30m):
- 0–10m: Product walkthrough focused on inference patterns relevant to your stack
- 10–20m: Throughput/latency demonstration and hosting options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
- 20–30m: Ops/security Q&A and next steps / mutual action plan

If any of the three windows doesn’t work, tell us two times that do and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to locking in something.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
